regions.name: Nyong
regions.quote: For example male fish from the River Nyong basin close to Sombo in Cameroon turn a stunning uniform blood red colour when in spawning condition whereas those from around Awae (also in the Nyong but further upstream) only exhibit this on the rear half of the body.

regions.name: Sanaga
regions.quote: Specimens from other localities within Cameroon such as the Sanaga, Ntem and Dja rivers exhibit similar, often subtle, differences.
